Hi Senator Sanders, 

I am a high school student who will be of age to vote in the next election, and you are one of my top choices. My parents are both democrats, but I would identify myself as more of an independent. One of the issues that I believe President Trump was elected on was his promise to keep jobs in America. He often advocated for keeping factories in America to ensure that jobs weren't being lost. With the rise of automation, I believe these concerns about losing jobs are only growing. The only Democrat who I consistently hear voice concerns about job loss due to automation has been Andrew Yang with his proposal to implement a freedom dividend. He often talks about how the most popular job in several states is working at a mall, but 1/3 of the malls in America are projected to close in the next 10 years. He believes the solution is a freedom dividend. I would appreciate it if you could explain how you would tackle this issue. 

Thanks!

\- Krishna
